correctness.rationale: Exact all-size proof: count every ideal, show VC=width via antichains, prove additive rank of disjoint-query products via splitting recurrence, then induction on two-step arms using exact branches. The positive lower-arm branch has rank t+s, the negative branch is the smaller class. For s>=1 it has rank t+s-1; for s=0 it has rank t. Other query types have deficient branches. Independent exhaustive implementations agree on all 20 tested parameter pairs (finite corroboration only).

value.rationale: Determines the exact adaptive dimension for an infinite two-parameter natural family of connected height-three posets of arbitrary width; characterizes a one-leaf boundary where a strict online/static separation disappears despite expansion of the concept domain. This exact structural effect is not forced by width or generic counting bounds, and gives explicit families with and without online excess at identical height.
